deals.whyRanked: $97 RT nonstop on American, down from $158, and Shenandoah National Park's Skyline Drive is under 90 minutes away.
deals.soloWhy: Free world-class Smithsonian museums, an extensive Metro system, and constant foot traffic on the Mall make this one of the easiest solo trips in the country.

highlights: National Mall & monuments lit up at night
itinerary: Day 1 — Air & Space and American History museums, walk the Mall to the Lincoln Memorial, catch the MLK and FDR memorials at sunset
Day 2 — Capitol Hill morning, Eastern Market lunch, National Gallery of Art in the afternoon, U Street for dinner
Day 3 — Georgetown waterfront and C&O Canal walk; rent a car for a day trip to Shenandoah's Skyline Drive if the weather's clear
guide.gettingAround: The Metro covers nearly everything downtown; a rental car is only worth it for the Shenandoah day trip.
guide.stayArea: Dupont Circle or Capitol Hill — central, Metro-accessible, and walkable after dark.
food: Compass Coffee for a morning start

deals.whyRanked: $117 RT nonstop on Southwest or Delta, and Fort McHenry National Monument sits right in the city — no drive required.
deals.soloWhy: Inner Harbor and Fells Point are walkable and well-lit, with a free water taxi and Circulator bus linking the main sights.

itinerary: Day 1 — Fort McHenry NM in the morning, Inner Harbor promenade, National Aquarium in the afternoon
Day 2 — Fells Point walking tour, water taxi to Canton, American Visionary Art Museum
Day 3 — Federal Hill Park for the skyline view; optional day trip to DC (35 min by train) or Annapolis
guide.gettingAround: Inner Harbor, Fells Point, and Federal Hill are all walkable; the Charm City Circulator bus is free downtown.
guide.stayArea: Fells Point or Inner Harbor — walkable, close to the water taxi stops.
food: Faidley's crab cakes at Lexington Market

deals.travelWindow: Sep 5 – Nov 19, some dates patchy — verify before booking
deals.whyRanked: $141 RT on Southwest, American, or JetBlue — cheaper than the $190-270 Denver fares in recent digests — and Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor is still just 90 minutes from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: A compact, walkable downtown with a free shuttle, plus an easy mountain day trip that needs no technical hiking skill.

itinerary: Day 1 — Union Station, 16th Street Mall, RiNo Art District mural walk
Day 2 — Day trip to Rocky Mountain NP for the Bear Lake corridor (in-park shuttle handles the parking)
Day 3 — Red Rocks Amphitheatre trails in the morning, Denver Botanic Gardens, Larimer Square for dinner
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable with a free 16th Street shuttle; a rental car is worth it for the Rocky Mountain NP day trip.
guide.stayArea: LoDo (Lower Downtown) — near Union Station and walkable to RiNo.

deals.whyRanked: $159 RT nonstop on American, with Everglades and Biscayne National Parks both under an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: South Beach's Art Deco district is walkable and busy at all hours, though a rental car is what really opens up the Everglades and Biscayne day trips.

highlights: South Beach Art Deco Historic District
itinerary: Day 1 — South Beach Art Deco walking tour, Lincoln Road, ocean swim
Day 2 — Everglades NP: Anhinga Trail boardwalk plus the Shark Valley bike loop
Day 3 — Wynwood Walls murals, Vizcaya Museum & Gardens, sunset at Bill Baggs park on Key Biscayne
guide.gettingAround: A rental car is worth it for the Everglades; South Beach itself is walkable, and the free Freebee shuttle covers Miami Beach.
guide.stayArea: South Beach's Art Deco district — walkable, close to the beach and Lincoln Road.

deals.whyRanked: $197 RT nonstop on JetBlue, down from $284, and Cabrillo National Monument and Torrey Pines are each a short trolley-and-drive from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: Balboa Park, the Gaslamp Quarter, and the coastal trolley make this one of the most solo-friendly warm-weather cities in the country.

itinerary: Day 1 — Balboa Park museums and Botanical Garden, Gaslamp Quarter for dinner
Day 2 — Cabrillo National Monument tide pools and the Old Point Loma Lighthouse, sunset at Sunset Cliffs
Day 3 — Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve hike, La Jolla Cove seals, trolley back downtown
guide.gettingAround: The MTS trolley and buses cover downtown, Old Town, and the beaches; a car isn't required but helps reach Torrey Pines faster.
guide.stayArea: Gaslamp Quarter or Little Italy — walkable, trolley-accessible, close to the bay.
